verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents account-level and project-level access tokens with scopes. A token can be limited to the post_client_item scope so it can only send events. Newly created tokens are encrypted and cannot be retrieved after creation. Together these give the core of least-privilege credential issuance, which could be used for an agent such as one connecting through the documented MCP server. A community report notes each project has a default read token that never expires and is not opt-in, which weakens the least-privilege defaults. Missing for 10: the full list of scopes (e.g. read vs. write), token expiry or rotation controls, guidance on credentials for agents or the MCP server, and independent hands-on corroboration.
